summary: Mercury Systems filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 15, 2026, its independent directors approved Amendment No. 2 to Chairman and CEO William L. Ballhaus's employment agreement, extending the initial term to August 15, 2030; all other terms remain unchanged. A September 16 press release announced the extension and reaffirmed the financial guidance issued on the August 18, 2026 earnings call. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation applies. The event is a CEO contract extension rather than an abrupt departure. Risk-arb angle: watch for any later governance or succession signals, though no deal mechanics are present.
